name: Tsunderera
source:
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tsunderella who worked backstage at a cross-dressing bar.

When Tsunderella's birthday arrives next week, he must work at the front of the bar....

Not wanting to be like his older sisters, Tsunderella is lured by a magician to the castle ball to find his destined one...!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10712]Freem[/url]]
translation:
从前，有个名叫桑德瑞拉的男孩，在一家女装酒吧后台工作。

下周就是桑德瑞拉的生日，他必须到酒吧前台工作……

不想变得像姐姐们一样，桑德瑞拉被魔术师引诱到城堡舞会，寻找命中注定之人……！

[翻译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10712]Freem[/url]]
